title: Analyses of the microbiome and mircobial metabolites in the prevention and treatment of Graft-versus-Host disease
summary: Ziel dieser Studie ist es die Nebenwirkung einer Stammzelltransplantation besser zu verstehen. Hier soll insbesondere die akute Abstoßungsreaktion des Darmes genauer untersucht werden und welche Rolle dabei das Mirkobiom spielt.

interventions.name: Patients receiving an allogeneic stem cell transplant. Stool samples are collected prior to allogeneic transplantation and on day d+1, +7, +14, +21, +28 and at the onset of GvHD or infection. Clinical data such as administration of antibiotics, occurrence of infections, graft-associated side effects

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
planned allogenic stem cell transplantation
Exclusion criteria:
CED, Hemoglobin <7g/dl, Thrombocytes <50/nl, Quick <50%
